urls.rationale: Legislative Law Article 1-A (sections 1-A through 1-V), titled LOBBYING ACT - the core NY lobbying-disclosure statute body (registration, reporting, enforcement).

notes: Legislative Law title page exposes Article 1-A explicitly labeled LOBBYING ACT, range 1-A - 1-V. Other articles (legislative ethics, committees, etc.) are out of scope for lobbying disclosure.
